scope: Simulation evidence for Recorded Replay and frozen Residual PPO. No physical robot validation is established.

definitions.step_height_mm: Vertical obstacle height in the simulated traversal task.
definitions.strict_success: Both the common assessment and the original controller native success condition are satisfied.
definitions.common_success: Common-assessment completion only; not interchangeable with strict success.
definitions.body_tilt_rms_deg: Root-mean-square inclination of the chassis from level, in degrees; lower means less overall inclination over the stated measurement window.
definitions.geometric_completion_window: Measured from control onset through each method's first geometric completion; not the complete native episode including settling.
definitions.mean_paired_percent_reduction: Average of case-by-case (Recording minus PPO) / Recording percentages. It is not a percentage computed from pooled means.
definitions.negative_reduction: A negative reduction means the metric increased.

caveats: Peak tilt is essentially unchanged and pitch RMS rises slightly.
Lower tilt RMS does not establish reduced jitter, improved support margins or uniformly smoother motion.

regression_100mm.scope: known original39 regression; used for failure diagnosis, not unseen generalization
caveats: Known conditions were used in diagnosis and development; this is not unseen generalization.
Posture subset excludes pairs where either method fails and must not be generalized to all 39 conditions.
RMS, peak, pitch and support diagnostics need separate interpretation.

holdout_100mm.scope: Eight fixed predeclared new gap/friction conditions, separate from the 39-condition regression suite.
caveats: Strict success is tied at 6/8; common-only completion must not replace the strict result.
All five jointly strict-successful pairs have lower tilt RMS but higher peak tilt and higher pitch RMS.
Small fixed simulator set; no hardware or broad-distribution robustness claim.
No-selection-use is attested in the source freeze record; chronology alone cannot prove no unrecorded adaptive use.

historical_50mm.scope: Historical frozen 50 mm policy; separate from the updated 100 mm model.
caveats: These are common-outcome counts, not the 100 mm strict outcome definition.
A successful selected nominal clip does not establish greater overall reliability.

media_caveats: Videos are renderings of retained measured simulator poses, not hardware footage.
All comparison videos retain full native episodes at 1x physical speed, with one shared camera and scale.
Earlier-finishing sides hold their exact final pose and timestamp.
Initial gaps are requested targets; actual startup-aligned gaps may differ slightly.
Selected videos are illustrative, not an unbiased estimate of performance.
